title: Insight Pump prime not reset canular time/date
symptom: When an Infusion site change was made at the pump then the canular date/time was not made/updated in AAPS. Treatment tab showing pump disconnect and connect with no prime in-between.
cause: The 'Log site changes' setting in Insight preferences was set to off.
fix: Enable the 'Log site changes' setting in Insight preferences.
evidence_quote: have you checked if in Insight preferences, "Log site changes" setting is enabled?
